dsh-provider-qoder
English | 简体中文
Use your Qoder subscription in DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
## Features

- Sign in through your browser or authenticate with a Personal Access Token (PAT).
- Switch between

Global and China service regions.
- Support for Qoder model queues with visible waiting progress.
-

Integrated Qoder web search.
- Multimodal input, image generation, and image search.
- Switch betwee
n the model's available context tiers during a conversation.

> [!NOTE]
> Daily check-ins and multi-account management are not supported.

In DSH Web, open **Settings → Models → Qoder account** and select your service region.
Click **Sign in with Qoder** and complete authorization on the website. Return to DSH to select a mo

## Feedback
Please report issues via GitHub Issues with the plugin and DSH versions, selected service region, re
production steps, and sanitized error messages. Do not submit PATs, short-lived tokens, or personal
account information.
